name: @sidleo3/dsh-wiki
description: DSH plugin for the llm-wiki knowledge base: OKF v0.2-conformant markdown bundle with progressive disclosure. Registers 14 tools: wiki_list/search/get/create/update/validate/lint/ingest/deprecate/rules/help/dirs/use/sync. Named multi-bundle directories with session/global switching, Git remote sync + Feishu cloud-drive online knowledge base (native .md), and a configuration page registered into the DSH slots settings.section (Settings → llm-wiki) and plugins.bundle.config (sidebar Plugins → bundle page), both unchanged across DSH 0.1.7-rc.2, 0.2.0-rc.1 and 0.2.1-rc.2: bundle registry / sync / health. Self-contained (vendor-core embedded).
